in_marathi.name: Guhan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Guhan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Guhan means 'Cave' in Sanskrit, Telugu, Malayalam, Tamil, Kannada, and Bengali. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Guha' which means 'cave' or 'secret'. This name is associated with protection and secrecy, and is often given to children born in times of danger or uncertainty.
